title.zh: Circle将自10月31日起削减旧版USDC跨链协议CCTP V1限额，12月1日暂停合约
title.en: Circle将自10月31日起削减旧版USDC跨链协议CCTP V1限额，12月1日暂停合约

current_state.zh: Circle will begin cutting legacy CCTP V1 burn limits on October 31 and pause the old contracts on December 1, 2026, forcing apps, wallets, and bridges onto the non-backward-compatible new CCTP, with Noble's USDC contracts and cross-chain routes set to pause January 12, 2027 ahead of manual redemption.
current_state.en: Circle will begin cutting legacy CCTP V1 burn limits on October 31 and pause the old contracts on December 1, 2026, forcing apps, wallets, and bridges onto the non-backward-compatible new CCTP, with Noble's USDC contracts and cross-chain routes set to pause January 12, 2027 ahead of manual redemption.
